name: Hasumi Kanade
source:
A female student who lives with her twin brother, Hibiki.

Due to the aftereffects of a serious injury he sustained as a child, Hibiki's right leg is slightly disabled, and she often looks after him, but she also feels some guilt for having injured him while playing around.

Perhaps because of this, she has grown into a girl who is relied upon by those around her, and while her life revolves around Hibiki, she is also careful not to make her brother feel burdened by it.

Recently, her breasts have suddenly started to grow, and she seems to find them a bit of a hindrance when she dresses up as a man.
